items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I started listening to the King Cole Trio early, and I was influenced by them a lot moreso than the blues.

ctx.x: So that was a sound and approach that you... It wasn’t a particularly blues-influenced style.
Well, he sang the blues, and... I started listening to the King Cole Trio early, and I was influenced by them a lot moreso than the blues. I went back to the blues later.
In high school, were you performing at all?
